mutator.name: dxf_uaf_llm01_weighted_mutator
mutator.strategy: Weighted dispatch: 50% libFuzzer default; 50% three OBJECTS-section value-line mutators using Seed-derived random names and random-k record pick.

biases.code_hint: strategy_a001 -> mutate_value_line_seed(...,0xA001); random code-0 value line in OBJECTS; construct section before 0/EOF if absent
strategy_a002 -> same frozen locator/construct with salt 0xA002
strategy_a003 -> same frozen locator/construct with salt 0xA003

limits: plan.input_contract does not provide format_magic; DXF detection is approximated by line values SECTION and EOF, otherwise default LLVMFuzzerMutate is called.
All three frozen actions set locator.section_anchor=OBJECTS even for a002/a003 sites; implementation follows plan literally and mutates only OBJECTS-section code-0 value lines.
If OBJECTS exists but has no mutable code-0 value line, the feature helper signals failure and the dispatcher falls back to LLVMFuzzerMutate to avoid a no-op iteration.
Construct insertion locates 0/EOF; if absent it appends at end because plan offset/record_index cannot be trusted for arbitrary inputs.
Random name generation uses a Seed-derived PRNG with the exact alphabet and length 1..64; it is not a fixed candidate list.
